jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales (scheme-wide window for participating NSW employers)
jobs.program: Summer Clerkship 2027/28 — NSW Clerkship Recruitment Program window
jobs.notes: Official scheme page publishes 2027 dates: applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027, offers from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027; 'closes' is null because the Society permits two different closing dates (11:59pm Sun 4 July and Sun 11 July 2027) depending on the participating firm, so the exact close date must be checked per employer.

Firm's own early-careers page states applications are currently closed and will open in June for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program — only the month is confirmed, no exact dates are published yet, so both fields are null.

jobs.program: Dive In (early-careers insight program), May 2027 intake
jobs.notes: Allens' graduate site states applications for the May 2027 Dive In program will open in March 2027 — month only, no exact dates published; note this is a pre-clerkship insight program rather than a clerkship or graduate role, and Allens' 2026/27 clerkship applications are shown as closed.

Firm's graduate centre confirms the 2026/27 program is closed and that 2027/28 clerkships will be advertised in line with the relevant Law Society/Institute guidelines, but no firm dates are published yet.

jobs.employer: Queensland Law Society (scheme-wide window for signatory QLD firms)
jobs.notes: QLS publishes only the 2027 cycle, whose window has already passed (opened 13 July 2026, closed 5pm AEST 7 August 2026); dates for the next cycle are not yet published on the official page, so no future window can be confirmed.

jobs.employer: Law Institute of Victoria (scheme-wide window for signatory VIC firms)
jobs.notes: The current published LIV guidelines are the 2026 edition, under which clerkship applications opened no earlier than 9am Monday 6 July 2026 (now passed); the 2027 guidelines with the next Schedule 1 dates could not be located on the LIV site, so no future dates are asserted.
